findings.text: blocking: at the reviewed head the departure hold is applied before the observer-context hold, and _release_expired (reckon/crew/ticker.py:1345-1358) delivers every expired departure unconditionally, so an observer row the pane withholds — e.g. the terminal echo complete -> recorded for a run the pane shows as complete — is held as a departure and then printed once the settle window passes, making a hidden row visible and inverting the pane's contract; the four cases and the 613-test gate pass over it, and the later commit 2f61639ce repairs exactly this ordering and adds the withheld-terminal-echo case that fails against c49f8921b.

follow-on: _pane_word duplicates the renderer's recovery-word substitution at ticker.py:2104-2113, so a new recovery word added to the pane vocabulary must be added in both places or the policy's judgement of what the pane draws will drift from the renderer.
